extracted.intended_audience: American writers, literary thinkers, and critics interested in forming a national literature
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for producing an American literature that expresses the national/moral idea, speaks to the People, and does more than mirror surface prosperity — a literature that trains, redeems, and builds character in a democratic nation.

rubrics_metrics.name: National aggregation of mighty poets and artists
rubrics_metrics.description: Possess the aggregation of a cluster of mighty poets, artists, teachers, fit for us, national expressers, comprehending and effusing for the men and women of the States, what is universal, native, common to all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim to produce a body of writers/artists who collectively express what is universal and native to the nation (inland and seaboard, northern and southern). The page contrasts this artistic/moral unity with political subjection and argues that moral/artistic fusion is the reliable national identity to build.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literature must embody the fervid and tremendous IDEA
rubrics_metrics.description: The true nationality of the States...is...neither the written law...nor self-interest...but the fervid and tremendous IDEA, melting everything else with resistless heat, and solving all lesser and definite distinctions in vast, indefinite, spiritual, emotional power.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works should aim to convey a dominant moral/ideational force that unifies disparate particulars — literature judged by its ability to present and carry a powerful, unifying idea rather than mere legal, economic, or sectional identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not substitute material prosperity for the soul of literature
rubrics_metrics.description: The soul of man will not with such only...be finally satisfied; but needs what...is address'd to the loftiest, to itself alone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid equating national achievement (railroads, ships, machinery, material prosperity) with the highest ends of literature. Anti-pattern: treating industrial/technical accomplishments as adequate literary subject or substitute for spiritual/artistic depth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create an American 'stock-personality' with common outlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Question of character, of an American stock-personality, with literatures and arts for outlets and return-expressions, and, of course, to correspond, within outlines common to all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop recurring, recognizable character-types or personality-grounds that reflect a shared national temperament; critics and thinkers should attend to formation of this common outline as a foundation for national literature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literature underlying life: religious and consistent with science
rubrics_metrics.description: A literature underlying life, religious, consistent with science, handling the elements and forces with competent power, teaching and training men.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strive for work that goes beneath surface appearance to address life’s deeper moral and spiritual issues, while remaining intellectually honest and consistent with scientific knowledge. Avoid mere surface-copying, pandering to taste, or showcasing technical/grammatical dexterity alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teaching and training as a literary purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: …a literature ... teaching and training men -- and, as perhaps the most precious of its results, achieving the entire redemption of woman ... and thus insuring to the States a strong and sweet Female Race, a race of perfect Mothers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value literature that has educative or formative aims: works should contribute to moral/civic development. The author singles out social redemption (notably of women) as an explicit end-result literature should pursue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Redeem and elevate women through literature
rubrics_metrics.description: Achieving the entire redemption of woman out of these incredible holds and webs of silliness, millinery, and every kind of dyspeptic depletion...insuring to the States a strong and sweet Female Race, a race of perfect Mothers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Portray and culturally promote stronger, saner, more substantial female characters and roles; combat literary tropes that reduce women to fashion, triviality, or silliness. This is an explicit social aim for national literature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize and reverently appreciate the People
rubrics_metrics.description: Literature, strictly consider'd, has never recognized the People... I know nothing more rare...than a fit scientific estimate and reverent appreciation of the People — of their measureless wealth of latent power and capacity, their vast, artistic contrasts of lights and shades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value works that seriously engage with the masses, their latent strengths and contradictions, rather than treating them as ungrammatical or merely vulgar. Anti-pattern: literature that excludes or derides the People, or only treats them as objects of satire.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portray strong personalities and full moral/religious civilization
rubrics_metrics.description: Always...we question, we ask, Are there, indeed, men here worthy the name? Are there athletes? Are there perfect women...Is there a great moral and religious civilization--the only justification of a great material one?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim to produce or depict robust, admirable personalities (athletic, majestic, morally vivid figures) and to promote an underlying moral/religious civilization in art — literature should justify material greatness by displaying corresponding moral depth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid flippancy, vulgarity, and literary superficiality
rubrics_metrics.description: Everywhere...are pervading flippancy and vulgarity, low cunning, infidelity...In fashionable life, flippancy, tepid amours, weak infidelism, small aims, or no aims at all, only to kill time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reject light, frivolous modes of writing that pander to fashion, ephemeral amusement, or badinage. The author warns that much contemporary conversation/literature is shallow; good literature must resist that tendency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not merely copy surfaces or pander to taste
rubrics_metrics.description: Not merely to copy and reflect existing surfaces, or pander to what is called taste -- not only to amuse, pass away time, celebrate the beautiful, the refined, the past, or exhibit technical, rhythmic, or grammatical dexterity -- but ... underlying life...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anti-pattern: works that are technically clever or aesthetically 'refined' but lack substantive engagement with life’s deeper moral, spiritual, or civic questions. Prioritize substance and living truth over ornament or pastiche.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconcile individualism with the mass character
rubrics_metrics.description: We shall...find the origin-idea of the singleness of man, individualism, asserting itself... But the mass, or lump character, for imperative reasons, is to be ever carefully weigh'd, borne in mind, and provided for. Only from it...comes the chance of individualism. The two are contradictory, but our task is to reconcile them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft literature that respects and develops individual uniqueness while remaining rooted in and responsive to the collective, democratic mass — the reconciliatory task is a central literary challenge in a democracy.
